name: Velvet Antenna v0.21.3 Velvet Lens
author: James
description: Standalone Velvet Antenna redesign focused on speed and a distinct browsing identity. v0.21.3 removes the remaining visible native Jellyfin library header/tab chrome so Movies, Series and Collections are fully owned by the Velvet Lens surface, while retaining the v0.21.2 detail PLAY/CONTINUE control, inline Identify workflow, duplicate resolution badges and confirmed direct deletion.
